description: Landfill Gas Collection, Use and Destruction is a dataset listed in Ontario open data catalogue, an open data portal, published or maintained by Environment, Conservation and Parks. This dataset provides a summary of information reported by landfills regarding their landfill gas collection (LFG), methane destruction and/or use, and associated emission reductions as required by Section 11 of O.Reg. 347 under the Environmental Protection Act. Coverage: Ontario. The portal files it under the publisher Environment, Conservation and Parks. Its tags are Environment and Natural Resources, Environnement et richesses naturelles, Greenhouse gas emissions, climate change, gaz d’enfouissement. It offers 3 resource(s) in PDF, XLSX. The portal shows 2026-07-27 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Open Government Licence – Ontario. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support infrastructure planning and operations studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-ontario-portal.
